note: INDENTATION BECOMES A PER-LINE PREFIX, and it is also the return value. Emacs answers ("  " "  aa bb\n  cc dd"): `adaptive-fill-mode' reads the first line's leading whitespace as the paragraph's fill prefix, re-applies it to every line it makes, and `fill-region' hands it back. kg's C fill already does the whitespace half of this (`reflow_indent_len' re-applies the first row's indent), so what the binding owes here is the RETURN VALUE rather than the layout. kg answers `void-function' at this pin.
